purpose: Convert the U.S. state/local public-pension case into a private-markets fee/liquidity/valuation acceptance test rather than a generic underfunding registry.

perimeter_layers.acceptance_test: assets, participants, contributions, benefits, and actuarial unit data are bound and current
plan ACFR/GASB/actuarial records replace aggregate comfort language
management fees, carried interest, performance fees, fund expenses, consultant fees, and offsets are bound net of returns
unfunded commitments, capital calls, lockups, distributions, secondary-sale haircuts, and liquidity stress are modeled
valuation policy, NAV lag, continuation vehicles, audit adjustments, and disclosure limits are explicit
industry-side strong-return claims are tested against audited net-of-fee, vintage-adjusted, survivorship-adjusted data
retirees, low-wage workers, new tiers, taxpayers, service users, future residents, bondholders, and manager fee claims are placed in the waterfall

hard_blockers: No certification without plan-level net-of-fee/carry data.
No condemnation without contrary performance evidence and method limits.
